claude.performance_metric: net revenue declined $30,852M (FY2018) to $26,982M (FY2020); FY2020 net loss $(322)M including $865M goodwill impairment
claude.rationale: The slice documents a declining-revenue, swing-to-loss trajectory with an $865M goodwill impairment on the HPC & MCS unit, plus transformation/cost programs (HPE Next, Cost Optimization Plan), but attributes the fiscal 2020 deterioration chiefly to COVID-19 and supply/manufacturing-capacity constraints rather than to any documented product/process misalignment. There is no line describing an acquired product failing to align with operating processes over time (p4), nor any fracture between operations and people/management/culture stemming from integration (p5). The workforce realignments are cost-structure driven and not tied to a documented integration conflict, so neither interface pathway can be affirmed or ruled out from this realized-outcome evidence; both are coded uncertain.
